description: What size generator you need for a power outage: add the running watts of everything you will run at once, then add the single biggest motor starting surge. Enter how many of each item you plan to run at the same time. Formula: Total running watts = Σ (quantity × running watts). Total starting watts = total running watts + the single highest additional starting watts among the items you run, because motors rarely start at the same instant. Amps at 240 V = running watts ÷ 240. Margin is an optional buffer you choose.
